_doc: CAD spec for T7 CARTRIDGE PEN hero — an OPEN-KIT scene (most complex). Layout from canonical target (tmp/discovery/T7_target.png, 1126x1234). A navy hard carry case lying HORIZONTAL with its hinged lid OPEN/up; inside, a white cartridge injection PEN in the foreground (lying along the case) + 3 dark-green cartridge vials standing in a moulded tray slot behind it; set on a light grey stone/marble surface. The only swappable text is the small label on the WHITE PEN body (product name + dose + form). gpt_image_2 generative + reference; the prompt MUST defer to the reference for the whole scene and change only the pen-label text. SKUs: bpc-157-pen, nad-injection-pen, ghk-cu-injectable (all Section 21/Unscheduled -> NO badge).

object.scene: open navy carry case, horizontal, lid up; white cartridge pen in foreground; 3 dark-green cartridge vials in a tray behind; light grey stone surface
object.label_on_pen: small white label on the white pen body: Regenic|Lab + product name + dose + form, navy text

artwork.swappable: ONLY the small label printed on the white pen body (product name, dose, form). Everything else (case, cartridges, surface) is fixed by the reference.

scene.camera: slight top-down 3/4 over the open case, horizontal composition
scene.framing: open case fills ~90% of frame width, centered
scene.lighting: soft key top-left, gentle shadows on the stone surface

prompt_template: Photorealistic e-commerce hero render of an OPEN pharmaceutical injection-pen carry kit. Match the attached reference image EXACTLY and reproduce the WHOLE scene faithfully — change ONLY the small text printed on the white pen's label. SCENE: a navy rigid carry case lying horizontal with its hinged lid open and standing up at the back; inside, a sleek WHITE cartridge injection pen rests in the foreground along the case, and three dark-green glass cartridge vials stand upright in a moulded tray slot behind it; everything sits on a light grey stone/marble surface. CAMERA: slight top-down three-quarter angle over the open case, the kit filling ~90% of frame width. LIGHTING: soft key from top-left, gentle realistic shadows on the stone. ON THE WHITE PEN, a small neat label in navy #1b2846, left-aligned: the 'Regenic|Lab' wordmark with cyan accent, the product name '{product_name}' (Montserrat SemiBold, the largest line on the small label), {dose_clause}and a small muted-grey 'SC · Cartridge Pen'. TYPOGRAPHY DISCIPLINE: keep the pen label small, crisp and legible exactly as in the reference; do not enlarge it or add text elsewhere; if no dose is specified do NOT invent one. There is NO schedule badge anywhere. Do NOT print 'Novecy' or any third-party/compounder branding. Clean premium clinical pharmacy, sharp focus, high detail, sRGB. 1126x1234.
